name: Berjaya Corporation Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团继续进行业务精简：多家子公司自愿清盘，并出售在Berjaya Property、Berjaya Food、Sports Toto、Citaglobal等公司的股权。同时，集团将出售所得资金用于支持放贷和股票经纪业务。此外，集团未公告新的重大合约或业务扩张。
overview_en: In 2026, the Group continued its business streamlining: several subsidiaries underwent voluntary winding-up, and it disposed of stakes in Berjaya Property, Berjaya Food, Sports Toto, Citaglobal and others. Proceeds from the disposals were used to support the moneylending and stockbroking businesses. No major new contracts or business expansions were announced.

segments.name: 消费者营销与零售
segments.note: 该板块今年涉及多家 dormant 子公司的清盘，以及印尼子公司清算完成。
segments.note_en: This segment saw the winding-up of several dormant subsidiaries and the completion of liquidation of an Indonesian subsidiary.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 这些公司已停止业务并处于休眠状态。
actions.text_en: Proposed members' voluntary winding-up of Berjaya Books, BLoyalty Marketing, Shinca Electronics and Berjaya 2nd Homes, which have ceased operations and are dormant.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: PT Berjaya Cosway Indonesia的自愿清算已完成，该公司不再为子公司。
actions.text_en: The voluntary liquidation of PT Berjaya Cosway Indonesia was completed, and it ceased to be a subsidiary.

segments.name: 物业
segments.note: 该板块今年涉及出售Berjaya Property Berhad的股份。
segments.note_en: This segment involved disposals of shares in Berjaya Property Berhad.

segments.note_en: At the group level, several equity disposals and fund allocations were made to streamline structure and support financial businesses.
